newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold ends mixed in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold ends mixed in active trade.

text.p: Prices on Istanbul's gold price were mixed in active trade on Monday as demand from the free market picked up after the weekend, dealers said.
Gold closed 5,750 lira higher at 1,094,500 lira per gram due to a weak Turkish lira against the dollar and $0.35 lower at $385.85 an ounce, in line with trends in European markets.
Volume leapt to 1,376 kilos from Friday's 833.

"It was normal for demand to be lively after weekend gold jewellery sales in the free market. Trade was very active in the morning because sellers found prices suitable. Activity died down in the afternoon because demand was met in the morning," said one dealer.
Traded volume was 1,366 kilos in the first session and only 10 kilos in the afternoon. 78 percent of the total trade was in lira terms.
Exchange members import gold and prefer to sell it in lira terms when the lira depreciates sharply against the dollar. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 0875. EKS
